check.name: Check
check.title: Check a mod (static, nothing is run)
check.intro: Quick check skips the slow tools. Untick it for the full check (several minutes on a big mod).

help.name: Start Here
help.title: Start Here: your first mod
help.intro: New to modding? Read this page top to bottom once. Nothing here changes any file.

prep.name: Prepare
prep.title: Prepare
prep.intro: ARSENAL reads the game and your mod once and keeps what it worked out, so pages open fast the next time. Here you can make that prepared data ahead of time, see what is ready, and remove it.

docs.name: Docs
docs.title: Engine and modding documentation
docs.intro: Read and search the modding guide and, where it is present, the engine technical document here, chapter by chapter or as one book. The documents are in English.

guides.name: Guides & External Tools
guides.title: Guides and external tools from other modders
guides.intro: Search about 9,000 links to guides and tools that modders wrote for GEM games (Men of War, Assault Squad 2, Gates of Hell and others). It works offline from a saved index.

claude.name: Claude
claude.title: ARSENAL for Claude: skills and MCP servers

units.name: Units
units.title: Units: find, read, rename, resize, add
units.intro: Find a unit by its name or id and read its stats in plain words. Here you rename it, change what it is made of or copy it into your mod; its numbers (price, armour, cooldown, rank) are changed under Balance, Quick changes. Every change is shown first; nothing is written until you press Write.

balance.name: Balance
balance.title: Balance: the whole buy panel at once
balance.intro: Every unit of the buy panel as one row. Narrow the list by anything, see it as a sheet, in groups, as a graph or side by side, find the units that do not fit the pattern, and change one value for all units on show. Nothing is written until you press Write.

models.name: Models
models.title: Models: a unit's 3D model, edited here
models.intro: Pick a unit or a model file. This page finds the files that make up its 3D model (model, meshes, armour volumes, animations, materials) and opens them for editing right here. The game files are only read: when you press Save, the files you changed are written into your mod folder, at the same place inside it.

maps.name: Maps
maps.title: Maps
maps.intro: Here you can look at the multiplayer maps, make your own copy of one, give it a name and a game mode, let bots play on it, and put an object on it.

missions.name: Missions
missions.title: Missions
missions.intro: A mission is what you play on a map: the flags, where each side starts and the events of one game mode. Here you can check a mission, or make a single-player mission with the card below.

art.name: Look & Sound
art.title: Look & Sound
art.intro: Change how a unit looks (textures), sounds, buy-menu pictures and models. Pick a job below, then use the helpers further down. The tool only reads the game. It writes only into your mod folder, and only after you confirm.

share.name: Share
share.title: Share my mod
share.intro: Get your mod ready for friends or the Steam Workshop. Each step says what it will do before it writes anything. Longer guide: guide/20-packaging-and-release.md.

modes.name: Game Modes
modes.title: Game Modes
modes.intro: A game mode is a mode card, set/multiplayer/games/<mode>.set, plus the lobby presets. The card holds the rules: score, time, teams, fog of war and whether bots may join. Every map of that mode uses the same card, so a change to it applies to all of those maps while your mod is on. The flags and start points of one map are its mission, on the Missions page.

bots.name: Bots
bots.title: Bots
bots.intro: Bots are the computer players of multiplayer games. Here you change what they buy, how rich they are, and try them in a match. Changes go into your mod only.

unitai.name: Unit AI
unitai.title: Unit AI
unitai.intro: How soldiers, crews and guns spot, aim and pick targets once they are on the map, for every AI unit, single-player enemies too. Changes go into your mod only.

mapai.name: Map scripts for AI
mapai.title: Map scripts for AI
mapai.intro: Orders the bot cannot give itself (extra units, attack, hold), written into one map. Changes go into your mod only.

files.name: Mod Files
files.title: Mod Files
files.intro: See every file of your mod, which file the game really uses, edit text files and search them. Changes are only written into your mod folder, after a preview. The game folder, its original data, packed files, Gates of Hell and Workshop folders are never changed.

pro.name: Expert Tools
pro.title: Expert Tools
pro.intro: Every ARSENAL tool in one list, diffs between mods and versions, stat sheets as tables, the mod conflict view and command lines to copy.

legend.read: full = every field the handler reads was found; partial = some were found, the handler also reads the body in a way the scan could not follow (see notes); none = not read
legend.writes: no = reads only; flag = writes only when body[flag] is true; dry = writes unless body[flag] is true (gui_call sets it unless the body says write true); always = every call writes; command = POST /api/run, by the command; launch = starts the game; blocked = gui_call never sends it; unknown = a POST the scan could not class, treated as always. always and unknown are sent by gui_call only with confirm_write: true; preview = the route beside it to call first; by: name = classed as a read by its last path word only
